text: Nitrogen fertilization exerts a highly significant effect on oat grain yield (F(3, 45) = 37.69, p < 1e-11).
Differences among oat varieties are non-significant when evaluated against whole-plot error (F(2, 10) = 1.49, p = 0.272).
The Variety x Nitrogen interaction is non-significant (F(6, 45) = 0.30, p = 0.932), confirming invariant nitrogen response across cultivars.
